title: A rapid HPLC-FLD method for Ochratoxin A detection in pig muscle, kidney, liver by using enzymatic digestion with MISPE extraction
author: Luci

steps.title: Collect and freeze tissue
steps.instruction: Obtain pig muscle, liver and kidney samples (e.g., from 10 animals), place them in labelled containers and store at –20 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion of tissue
steps.instruction: Digest the frozen tissue according to the referenced enzymatic digestion method (details not provided in the source).

steps.title: Dilute digested sample
steps.instruction: Dilute the digested sample 1:1 (v/v) with 0.1 M HCl solution adjusted to pH 1, ensuring the final volume does not exceed 10 mL.

steps.title: Condition MISPE column
steps.instruction: Pass 3 mL acetonitrile followed by 3 mL deionized water through the molecularly imprinted solid‑phase extraction (MISPE) column to equilibrate the sorbent.

steps.title: Load sample onto column
steps.instruction: Apply the entire diluted digested sample (maximum 10 mL) onto the conditioned MISPE column at a steady flow rate.

steps.title: Wash column (optimized protocol)
steps.instruction: No washing step is performed in the optimized protocol for pig tissues.

steps.title: Elute OTA from column
steps.instruction: Elute the retained ochratoxin A by passing 6 mL of acetic acid/methanol (2 % v/v acetic acid, 98 % v/v methanol) through the column.

steps.title: Prepare eluate for HPLC‑FLD
steps.instruction: Collect the eluate; if necessary, evaporate the solvent under a gentle nitrogen stream and re‑constitute in the mobile‑phase solvent before injection into the HPLC‑FLD system.
